blockingIssues.description: Runbook claims stale-overwrite protection was tested, but transcript evidence shows the direct `remote-apply-dev-bundle.sh /tmp/test-stale-bundle` execution timed out and verification switched to token-comparison simulation (`would reject as remote_newer`). This is not an end-to-end apply-path validation required by VAL-RUNTIME-007.

Runbook claims clean restore from a fresh bundle, but transcript evidence shows a quick export that skipped ClickHouse volume archives and no full import/apply of declared binds+directories+tracked volumes. Validation was reduced to read-only checks plus a bind-file round-trip, which does not satisfy VAL-RUNTIME-007A.

The feature contract required lifecycle hardening without altering stable/dev startup behavior outside test mode, but this commit still wires runtime startup paths (`initializeRealtimeServer(server)` at line 196 and `startAudioTranscriptionRunner()` at line 216) in normal server boot. These remain out of scope for the assigned lifecycle-only fix.

`stopAudioTranscriptionRunner()` only clears `runnerHandle` and returns. It does not await an already-running `runAudioTranscriptionTick()` (line 525) or settle `activeJobs` (line 533 onward). Since interval ticks invoke `void runAudioTranscriptionTick()` (lines 568-569), queue work can continue after stop is called, so teardown is not guaranteed quiescent before Mongo disconnect.

Rail image isolation is still incomplete. The script defaults `LOCAL_CODE_SANDBOX_PYTHON_IMAGE` to a shared tag (`librechat-local-sandbox-python:latest`) and rebuilds it on start when unchanged. Because both rails also default to this same tag in compose (`docker-compose.local.override.yml:189`), dev rebuild/start can mutate the sandbox artifact used by stable, violating expected rail isolation by image tags.

Stable-to-dev Mongo refresh still shells unescaped credentials into the remote command (`-u $MUSER -p $MPASS`). Passwords with shell metacharacters or spaces are valid and can break or alter command parsing, so the sync path is not robust for VAL-RUNTIME-008 behavior.
